dct_description_sm: This staging survey is a recruiting survey for Ipsos Canada polls held during the 41st Ontario General Election, held on June 12, 2014.  An online survey tool was used to identify respondents willing to participate in Ipsos pre-debate and post-debate surveys, as well as a series of mini-polls known as the 5-Week Omnibus Survey. Within the staging survey itself, Respondents reveal their voter attitudes and preferences in the 41st Ontario general election, including voting intention, leadership abilities of party leaders, as well as the biggest issues facing Ontarians during the election. This study has a sample of 9,727 respondents.
